en: The image shows a vintage black-and-white postcard featuring a waterfront scene with a traditional sailboat docked in front of a group of neoclassical buildings. The architecture is typical of the eastern Mediterranean, with tiled roofs and symmetrical windows. There is Greek text on the buildings and a Greek postage stamp in the upper right corner. Handwritten script appears at the bottom, likely a date and location.
